prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic live-action footage, fixed close camera with the physical cause visible. Use naturally recorded, close and detailed location/foley audio synchronized to the visible motion. Perform three short distinct occurrences at roughly 0.8, 2.5 and 4.3 seconds; each should vary slightly in force, timing and texture and then stop. Leave a quiet gap and complete the natural decay between occurrences. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, electronic synthesizer, chiptune, 8-bit sound, UI sounds, cartoon sounds, reverb wash, or added cinematic riser. No montage, no cuts, no titles. A real steel throwing knife travels through the air and embeds in a firm wooden practice target, no person in frame. Capture the thin blade pass and short solid metal-and-wood impact. A medium steel throwing knife embeds decisively in wood: crisp air cut, short metallic bite and natural woody thock.
prompt_records.evidence: generation prompt recorded with crop SHA

alternate_use: Use as a layer with the reviewed route gain and start anchor.
For a new target, re-anchor the main onset and audition material/scale; matching peak dBFS alone is insufficient.
avoid_when: A crop carrying several audible events must not be repeated once per hit.
Source-specific rejected contexts are not automatically reusable.

intensity_profile.note: Generation order does not determine intensity. These are reviewed usage levels and separate signal measurements, not a universal perceptual ranking.

prompt_factors.source: descriptors from reviewed uses; actual prompt text only in prompt_records when traced
